newsitem.title: CANADA: Sino-Forest sets C$30 mln warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: Sino-Forest sets C$30 mln warrant issue.

text.p: Sino-Forest Corp said on Wednesday it has an underwriting agreement to sell 24 million warrants at C$1.25 each to raise C$30 million.

Each warrant entitles the holder to one class A subordinate voting share of Sino-Forest. It said each warrant will be worth 1.1 class A shares if a receipt has not been issued for the company's prospectus by applicable Canadian security commissions.
The offering is being underwritten by First Marathon Securities Ltd, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, GTL Securities Inc and Sprott Securities Ltd.
The company said it will use the proceeds primarily to finance the phase in of its joint venture tree plantations in southern China and for expansion of chipping plants and port facilities.
